interface.title: SiOC/SiOCN Battery Anode Designer
interface.field: Materials science: polymer-derived ceramic (SiOC/SiOCN) anodes for lithium-ion batteries
interface.stage_of_work: Pre-synthesis design screening and interpreting results against the literature
interface.what_it_is_for: Enter a Si/C/O/N composition and pyrolysis conditions to predict first-cycle reversible and irreversible capacity, Coulombic efficiency and cycled capacity, see whether the inputs fall outside the training range, and get literature-guided precursor routes and analog papers for that composition.

data.note: Everything comes from the bundled model file. The app loaded with defaults Si 35, C 45, O 18, N 0 wt.%, 1000 C for 1 h and 100 cycles (screens/005.webp). Routes and analogs come from a curated public DOI table in the bundle. There is no upload or demo button.

tree.general: Screen a candidate material design for expected performance, decide how far to trust the prediction, and find literature recipes to make it
tree.specific: Predict QRev, QIrrev, CE and Qcycled for a SiOC/SiOCN composition and pyrolysis schedule, check the training-range flags, then look at phase proxies, synthesis routes and literature analogs

features.name: Composition/process input form with live property cards
features.general: Enter a material recipe as numeric fields and see the predicted property values update immediately, with derived quantities computed from them
features.specific: Sidebar Si/C/O/N wt.% and pyrolysis temperature/time number inputs drive QRev, QIrrev (= Qrev*(100/CE-1)) and CE metric cards, plus a sum-to-100 wt.% warning
steps: Type the processing temperature and time
Read the property cards and any composition-sum warning
serves_tasks: Enter a candidate composition and processing conditions and read the predicted properties
Screen a nitrogen-containing variant of the material

features.name: Training-domain applicability check
features.general: Flag each input as inside or outside the range the model learned from, and warn that out-of-range results are hypotheses
features.specific: 'Input range checks' list (green inside / red outside, with training and common ranges) plus the sidebar 'Discovery extrapolation' warning naming the offending elements; the BET row appears when the surface model is on
steps: Read per-input inside/outside labels with training and common ranges
Read the extrapolation warning listing out-of-range inputs
Treat the flagged prediction as a screening hypothesis
serves_tasks: Check whether each input lies inside the range the model was trained on

features.name: Prediction-mode selector with measured-value override
features.general: Choose whether a prediction uses only design inputs, a predicted intermediate, or a measured intermediate the user types in
features.specific: Radio groups 'CE estimate' and 'Cyclability estimate' (Diagnostic using predicted Qrev / Design-only / Diagnostic using measured Qrev); the measured Qrev field turns on only in measured mode, and a mode caption appears under the cards
steps: If measured mode, type the measured value
Compare the updated cards and mode caption
serves_tasks: Switch between design-only prediction and diagnostic prediction that reuses predicted capacity
Feed a measured value back in to refine the downstream predictions

features.name: Horizon selector for degradation prediction
features.general: Pick a usage horizon and see the predicted remaining performance and retention ratio
features.specific: 'Cycle number for cyclability' dropdown (50/100/200) updates the 'QCycled at N Cycles' and 'Apparent Retention' cards
serves_tasks: Predict how much performance remains after repeated use, at several cycle counts

features.name: Optional characterization-assisted model toggle
features.general: Turn on an alternative model that takes an extra measured property, and enter that property
features.specific: 'Use optional surface-assisted model' checkbox turns on the BET surface area input, switches the Qrev and Qcycled estimators, and adds a BET range check
steps: Read the changed predictions and the new range check
serves_tasks: Add an optional measured characterization value to use a richer model

features.name: Model validation summary
features.general: Show which models are used and how they scored under grouped versus shuffled cross-validation, so users can judge reliability
features.specific: Model Results tab: 'Workflow model bundles' table (estimator, rows, groups), grouped vs shuffled CV table with explanation, and 'Selected model CV summaries' for Qrev, CE design, CE diagnostic and Qcycled

Read the selected model CV summaries per target
serves_tasks: Review how the models were validated

features.name: Composition-to-phase proxy breakdown
features.general: Convert an elemental composition into estimated constituent-phase fractions and formulas to help interpret it
features.specific: Phase Descriptors tab: SiO2-like/SiC-like/free-carbon/Si3N4-like proxy bars, normalized phase percentages, Total/Matrix/Split formula chips, and raw proxy tables
steps: Read the proxy bars and normalized percentages
Read the formula chips and raw proxy table

features.name: Nearest-neighbour recipe recommender with match filters
features.general: Search a reference library for the items closest to a target, group them into recipe families, filter by similarity, and present a top suggestion with its source
features.specific: Synthesis Routes tab: 'Number of literature analogs to search' slider (8-40) and 'Minimum composition match for route family (%)' slider (5-100) produce a ranked route table (precursor, DVB, pyrolysis T/time, similar samples, family match, closest match, confidence) with a Search box, and a 'Top recipe idea' with a DOI link

Scan or search the ranked route table
